faqs.question: What types of storage tanks and receivers does Dhruv EPC fabricate?
faqs.answer: Fixed-cone-roof and open-top cylindrical storage tanks, process storage tanks (jacketed or insulated), rubber-lined corrosion-resistant vessels, and shop-fabricated ASME Sec. VIII Div. 1 air receivers for compressed-air and nitrogen service.

faqs.question: Do you fabricate both shop-built and site-erected tanks?
faqs.answer: Yes — smaller tanks and air receivers are fully shop-fabricated and dispatched as complete units; larger field-erected storage tanks are pre-fabricated in sections and assembled at site.

faqs.question: Which materials of construction are available for storage tanks?
faqs.answer: Carbon steel, stainless steel (SS 304 and 316) for corrosive service, and rubber-lined carbon steel for acid and slurry storage.

faqs.question: Can the works fabricate rubber-lined storage vessels?
faqs.answer: Yes — carbon steel vessels with hard or soft rubber lining are fabricated for acid, corrosive chemical and slurry service. Lining specification and holiday test are per client ITP.

faqs.question: What sectors use your storage tanks?
faqs.answer: Refineries & petrochemicals, fertilizers, water treatment, and the chemicals industry — the same sectors served by the pressure vessel and heat exchanger business from Manjusar GIDC, Vadodara.
